title: Going deeper: Hear the sentence twice
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Notice adult pressure, observable cues and the sentence that is about to leave the mouth.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
practice: hear the words as information and as possible impact
principle: Consider how one sentence may communicate more than its literal instruction.
nextSentence: The mistake needs useful feedback. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can hear the words as information and as possible impact.
keyLearning: Consider how one sentence may communicate more than its literal instruction.
